title: Implement canonical Command SLA Tracking CAP-CMD-105 in bounded read-only and future mutation units
goal: Implement CAP-CMD-105 progressively under Command operational SLA owner while preserving external deployment/contract policy source and OPEN-013 Class-2 decisions; the first unit is only owner-authorized Class-0 SLA inspection on selected work item.
invariants: Command owns operational Incident/Task SLA projection, external tenant/customer policy retains source ownership under validated ADR-0008.
Class-2 pause/resume/follow-up and audit are NOT decided by read-only inspection; OPEN-013 remains open.
The epic is a non-executable decomposition container; one read-only sublot does not establish capability acceptance or production readiness.
security_properties: No tenant/environment widening from Customer or policy references.
SLA source and object owner permissions remain independent; no client-derived grants.
No mutation of Incident, Task, policy or contract from read-only work.

migration.rationale: Planning container only; no canonical object schema or provider migration.

rollback.strategy: Remove only unaccepted child runtime without altering canonical contracts or prior Command releases.
verification: All prior Command first-party six-view Work Queue tests continue running.

inputs: Complete canonical CAP-CMD-105 and CAP-CMD-101, Command module, ADR-0008 contractual vs operational SLA split and OPEN-013.
Existing first-party Command queue six views, selected owner-authorized row and host sessions.
outputs: E10-CMD-105A-READONLY selected-only authorized operational SLA projection as one independently bounded child.
Further SLA owner/policy calculation, Class-2 pause/resume/audit and production deployment remain separately scoped, NOT claimed implemented.
acceptance_tests: Child tests, CI and source authorization separately from full epic and native approvals.
Epic stays DECOMPOSED until canonical obligations accepted.
definition_of_ready: E10-SCALE-005B is VERIFIED; CAP-CMD-105 has canonical Command owner and Class-0 inspection allowed even while Class-2 OPEN-013 remains unresolved.
definition_of_done: All CAP-CMD-105 canonical SLA source/policy/calendar, tenancy, due/remaining, pause/resume, provenance/audit and source owner integrations demonstrably accepted; no assumption from first Class-0 slice.
